verses.original: וְהַנַּ֧עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל מְשָׁרֵ֥ת אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י עֵלִ֑י וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֤ה יָקָר֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין חָז֖וֹן נִפְרָֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·na·‘ar šə·mū·’êl mə·šā·rêṯ ’eṯ- Yah·weh lip̄·nê ‘ê·lî ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh yā·qār bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ’ên ḥā·zō·wn nip̄·rāṣ
verses.literal: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare and visions were scarce
verses.literalPt: E O JOVEM Samuel servia ao SENHOR perante Eli; e a palavra do SENHOR era de muita valia naqueles dias; não havia visão manifesta.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ב בִּמְקֹמ֑וֹ וְעֵינוֹ הֵחֵ֣לּוּ כֵה֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·‘ê·lî šō·ḵêḇ bim·qō·mō wə·ʿē·nō hê·ḥêl·lū ḵê·hō·wṯ lō yū·ḵal lir·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: And at that time . . . Eli whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see was lying in his room
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu, naquele dia, que, estando Eli deitado no seu lugar (e os seus olhos começavam a escurecer, pois não podia ver),

verses.original: וְנֵ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ טֶ֣רֶם יִכְבֶּ֔ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל שֹׁכֵ֑ב בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṭe·rem yiḵ·beh ū·šə·mū·’êl šō·ḵêḇ bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh ’ă·šer- šām ’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Before the lamp of God had gone out Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD where the ark of God was located
verses.literalPt: E estando também Samuel já deitado, antes que a lâmpada de Deus se apagasse no templo do SENHOR, onde estava a arca de Deus,

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā Yah·weh ’el- šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . called to Samuel and he answered Here I am
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR chamou a Samuel, e disse ele: Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רָץ אֶל־ עֵלִ֗י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הִנְנִי֙ כִּֽי־ קָרָ֣אתָ לִּ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לֹֽא־ קָרָ֖אתִי שׁ֣וּב שְׁכָ֑ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ ’el- ‘ê·lî way·yō·mer hin·nî kî- qā·rā·ṯā lî way·yō·mer lō- qā·rā·ṯî šūḇ šə·ḵāḇ way·yê·leḵ way·yiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: He ran to Eli and said Here I am for you have called me I did not call Eli replied Go back and lie down So he went and lay down
verses.literalPt: E correu a Eli, e disse: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Mas ele disse: Não te chamei eu, torna a deitar-te. E foi e se deitou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֗ה קְרֹ֣א עוֹד֮ שְׁמוּאֵל֒ וַיָּ֤קָם שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לֹֽא־ קָרָ֥אתִי בְנִ֖י שׁ֥וּב שְׁכָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ Yah·weh qə·rō ‘ō·wḏ šə·mū·’êl way·yā·qām šə·mū·’êl way·yê·leḵ ’el- ‘ê·lî way·yō·mer hin·nî kî qā·rā·ṯā lî way·yō·mer lō- qā·rā·ṯî ḇə·nî šūḇ šə·ḵāḇ
verses.literal: Once again . . . the LORD called Samuel So Samuel got up went to Eli and said Here I am for you have called me My son I did not call Eli replied Go back and lie down
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR tornou a chamar outra vez a Samuel, e Samuel se levantou, e foi a Eli, e disse: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Mas ele disse: Não te chamei eu, filho meu, torna a deitar-te.

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל טֶ֖רֶם יָדַ֣ע אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְטֶ֛רֶם יִגָּלֶ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mū·’êl ṭe·rem yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·ṭe·rem yig·gā·leh ’ê·lāw də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him
verses.literalPt: Porém Samuel ainda não conhecia ao SENHOR, e ainda não lhe tinha sido manifestada a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף יְהוָ֥ה קְרֹא־ שְׁמוּאֵל֮ בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית֒ וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיָּ֣בֶן עֵלִ֔י כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵ֥א לַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ Yah·weh qə·rō- šə·mū·’êl baš·šə·li·šîṯ way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- ‘ê·lî way·yō·mer hin·nî kî qā·rā·ṯā lî way·yā·ḇen ‘ê·lî kî Yah·weh qō·rê lan·nā·‘ar
verses.literal: Once again for the third time the LORD called to Samuel He got up went to Eli and said Here I am for you have called me Then Eli . . . realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR, pois, tornou a chamar a Samuel terceira vez, e ele se levantou, e foi a Eli, e disse: Eis-me aqui, porque tu me chamaste. Então entendeu Eli que o SENHOR chamava o jovem.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵלִ֣י לִשְׁמוּאֵל֮ לֵ֣ךְ שְׁכָב֒ וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ דַּבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·lî liš·mū·’êl lêḵ šə·ḵāḇ wə·hā·yāh ’im- yiq·rā ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’ā·mar·tā dab·bêr Yah·weh kî šō·mê·a‘ ‘aḇ·de·ḵā way·yê·leḵ šə·mū·’êl way·yiš·kaḇ bim·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: Go and lie down he said to Samuel and if He calls you . . . say Speak LORD for Your servant is listening So Samuel went and lay down in his place
verses.literalPt: Por isso Eli disse a Samuel: Vai deitar-te e há de ser que, se te chamar, dirás: Fala, SENHOR, porque o teu servo ouve. Então Samuel foi e se deitou no seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יְהוָה֙ וַיִּתְיַצַּ֔ב וַיִּקְרָ֥א כְפַֽעַם־ בְּפַ֖עַם שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל׀ שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ דַּבֵּ֔ר כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō Yah·weh way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣaḇ way·yiq·rā ḵə·p̄a·‘am- bə·p̄a·‘am šə·mū·’êl šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl dab·bêr kî šō·mê·a‘ ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD came and stood there calling as before . . . Samuel Samuel And Samuel answered Speak for Your servant is listening
verses.literalPt: Então veio o SENHOR, e pôs-se ali, e chamou como das outras vezes: Samuel, Samuel. E disse Samuel: Fala, porque o teu servo ouve.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הִנֵּ֧ה אָנֹכִ֛י עֹשֶׂ֥ה דָבָ֖ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־ שֹׁ֣מְע֔וֹ תְּצִלֶּ֖ינָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- šə·mū·’êl hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·śeh ḏā·ḇār bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer kāl- šō·mə·‘ōw tə·ṣil·le·nāh šə·tê ’ā·zə·nāw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Samuel . . . I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Samuel: Eis que vou fazer uma coisa em Israel, a qual todo o que ouvir lhe tinirão ambos os ouvidos.

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ אָקִ֣ים אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ הָחֵ֖ל וְכַלֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’ā·qîm ’el- ‘ê·lî ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- bê·ṯōw hā·ḥêl wə·ḵal·lêh
verses.literal: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his house from beginning to end
verses.literalPt: Naquele mesmo dia suscitarei contra Eli tudo quanto tenho falado contra a sua casa, começarei e acabarei.

verses.original: וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־ שֹׁפֵ֥ט אֲנִ֛י אֶת־ בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲשֶׁר־ יָדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ מְקַֽלְלִ֤ים לָהֶם֙ בָּנָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א כִהָ֖ה בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hig·gaḏ·tî lōw kî- šō·p̄êṭ ’ă·nî ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ba·‘ă·wōn ’ă·šer- yā·ḏa‘ kî- mə·qal·lîm lā·hem bā·nāw wə·lō ḵi·hāh bām
verses.literal: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knows because his sons blasphemed God . . . and he did not restrain them
verses.literalPt: Porque eu já lhe fiz saber que julgarei a sua casa para sempre, pela iniqüidade que ele bem conhecia, porque, fazendo-se os seus filhos execráveis, não os repreendeu.

verses.original: וְלָכֵ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְבֵ֣ית עֵלִ֑י אִֽם־ יִתְכַּפֵּ֞ר עֲוֺ֧ן בֵּית־ עֵלִ֛י בְּזֶ֥בַח וּבְמִנְחָ֖ה עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·ḵên niš·ba‘·tî lə·ḇêṯ ‘ê·lî ’im- yiṯ·kap·pêr ‘ă·wōn bêṯ- ‘ê·lî bə·ze·ḇaḥ ū·ḇə·min·ḥāh ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never . . . . . . be atoned for by sacrifice or offering
verses.literalPt: Portanto, jurei à casa de Eli que nunca jamais será expiada a sua iniqüidade, nem com sacrifício, nem com oferta de alimentos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁמוּאֵל֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־ דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֣ל יָרֵ֔א מֵהַגִּ֥יד אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֖ה אֶל־ עֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ šə·mū·’êl ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer way·yip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- dal·ṯō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·šə·mū·’êl yā·rê mê·hag·gîḏ ’eṯ- ham·mar·’āh ’el- ‘ê·lî
verses.literal: Samuel lay down until the morning then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD He was afraid to tell Eli the vision . . .
verses.literalPt: E Samuel ficou deitado até pela manhã, e então abriu as portas da casa do SENHOR; porém temia Samuel relatar esta visão a Eli.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א עֵלִי֙ אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ‘ê·lî ’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl bə·nî way·yō·mer hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: but Eli called to him and said Samuel my son Here I am answered Samuel
verses.literalPt: Então chamou Eli a Samuel, e disse: Samuel, meu filho. E disse ele: Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ נָ֥א תְכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֤ אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף אִם־ תְּכַחֵ֤ד מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר מִכָּל־ הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber ’ê·le·ḵā ’al- nā ṯə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mim·men·nî kōh ya·‘ă·śeh- lə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōh yō·w·sîp̄ ’im- tə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mim·men·nî dā·ḇār mik·kāl had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: What was the message He gave you . . . Eli asked Do not . . . hide it from me May God punish . . . you and ever so severely if you hide from me anything . . . . . . He said to you
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Qual é a palavra que te falou? Peço-te que não ma encubras; assim Deus te faça, e outro tanto, se me encobrires alguma palavra de todas as que te falou.

verses.original: וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֤וֹ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א כִחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yag·geḏ- lōw šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm wə·lō ḵi·ḥêḏ mim·men·nū way·yō·mar Yah·weh hū haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·ʿē·nå̄w ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: So Samuel told him everything . . . and did not hide a thing from him He is the LORD replied Eli Let Him do what is good in His eyes
verses.literalPt: Então Samuel lhe contou todas aquelas palavras, e nada lhe encobriu. E disse ele: Ele é o SENHOR; faça o que bem parecer aos seus olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַֽיהוָה֙ הָיָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ הִפִּ֥יל מִכָּל־ דְּבָרָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·dal šə·mū·’êl Yah·weh hā·yāh ‘im·mōw wə·lō- hip·pîl mik·kāl də·ḇā·rāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: And Samuel grew and the LORD was with him and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground
verses.literalPt: E crescia Samuel, e o SENHOR era com ele, e nenhuma de todas as suas palavras deixou cair em terra.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדָּ֖ן וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֚י נֶאֱמָ֣ן שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל לְנָבִ֖יא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏa‘ kāl- yiś·rā·’êl mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘ kî ne·’ĕ·mān šə·mū·’êl lə·nā·ḇî Yah·weh
verses.literal: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E todo o Israel, desde Dã até Berseba, conheceu que Samuel estava confirmado por profeta do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥סֶף יְהוָ֖ה לְהֵרָאֹ֣ה בְשִׁלֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ נִגְלָ֨ה יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל בְּשִׁל֖וֹ בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ Yah·weh lə·hê·rā·’ōh ḇə·ši·lōh kî- niḡ·lāh Yah·weh ’el- šə·mū·’êl bə·ši·lōw biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the LORD continued to appear at Shiloh because there He revealed Himself to Samuel by His word
verses.literalPt: E continuou o SENHOR a aparecer em Siló; porquanto o SENHOR se manifestava a Samuel em Siló pela palavra do SENHOR.
